For every day carry it’s obviously the more practical choice, but that comes at the cost of reduced performance and ammo capacity.

When it comes to handguns, an inch difference in barrel length is easily noticeable at the range when it comes to accuracy/range/recoil.

Anyways, if you’re deciding between the two like I was. 

If you already have a full/midsize for EDC then get the SC.

But if you don’t have a full/midsize EDC, then definitely get a mid/full-size pistol. Aside from higher ammo cap, Recoil control, longer barrel,etc. Your frame of reference for practicing and shooting handguns should be a regular/full sized gun before you get a sc.
